title: Phonetic Atlas of Germany (PAD)
manual_annotation_evidence: Professional phonetic transcribers produced narrow phonetic transcriptions 1980-1995; independent transcriptions by two transcribers were evaluated; later broad TextGrids are WebMAUS-aligned then manually corrected
lineage_decision: Original recordings are elicited dialect production from 182-186 locations; later PAD analyses are reuse of those primary recordings and must share one recording lineage
reason: Strong qualifying manual phonetic layer, but do not core-admit until a public authoritative deposit/file set and redistribution terms are located and the original narrow-transcription layer is separated from newer corrected alignments
counts_known: 30,422 narrow-transcribed tokens across 182 locations; ~3,800 phonetically specified allophones; later work-in-progress aligned set reported 25 recordings
next_action: Locate authoritative public PAD files; enumerate machine-readable X-SAMPA/IPA and corrected TextGrid/CSV objects; capture license/checksums; deduplicate 182-location original corpus vs newer 25-recording alignment subset
